frame1.phrase1: It all started with a simple promise... letting machines do the programming

frame3.phrase1: The code is of high quality... but it also hides serious dangers...

frame5.phrase1: ...but this time, we didn't ignore them

frame6.phrase1: Small errors revealed deep flaws, and each failure showed us the path to correction
frame6.phrase2: Systems broke down, but each collapse taught us to see beyond the surface of the algorithm
frame6.phrase3: We learned to review, test, and question every line — retaking control of our own code
frame6.phrase4: In the end, AI stopped being the master of the world to become our greatest ally

frame1.phrase1: Faced with the chaos of the city, one company was stubborn
frame1.phrase2: While others backed down, you stepped forward

frame2.phrase1: Now, with everything in Total Meltdown, the system issues endless alerts
frame2.phrase2: Every corrupted line of code cries out for your correction. The entire world depends on your commands

frame3.phrase1: You are the last barrier between the AI and the ultimate collapse
frame3.phrase2: But errors arise faster than you can fix them. Too many tasks, too little time
frame3.phrase3: No matter how hard you try, your hands can't reach all the nodes. The AI spreads... and you realize that this time, it won't be enough
